token " two" means w = 7, kn = 1   # sort, from documentation
token " types" means w = 10, kn = 1   # sum, from documentation
token " unaffected" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token " unchanged" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token " undo" means w = 6, kn = 1   # reverse, from extract 0.149
token " unique" means w = 15, kn = 1   # unique, from name
token " unnamed" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token " unordered" means w = 15, kn = 1   # unique, from documentation
token " upper" means w = 16, kn = 1   # upper, from name
token " uppercase" means w = 16, kn = 1   # upper, from name
token " use" means w = 10, kn = 1   # sum, from documentation
token " versa" means w = 6, kn = 1   # reverse, from model
token " wider" means w = 11, kn = 1   # max, from model
token " widgets" means w = 9, kn = 1   # count, from model
token " width" means w = 9, kn = 1   # count, from model
token " with" means kn = 1   # filler
token " without" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token " word" means w = 4, kn = 1   # words, from name
token " words" means w = 4, kn = 1   # words, from name
token " zer" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token " zero" means w = 18, kn = 1   # first, from model
token "\q" means ans = 1
token "\q\q." means ans = 1
token "#" means hash = 1, kn = 1
token "(" means ans = 1
token "()" means ans = 1
token "(dict" means ans = 1
token ")" means ans = 1
token "))" means ans = 1
token "," means kn = 1, ans = 1
token ".from" means ans = 1
token ".lower" means ans = 1
token ".split" means ans = 1
token ".upper" means ans = 1
token "0" means ans = 1
token "1" means ans = 1
token "2" means ans = 1
token "=True" means ans = 1
token "=len" means ans = 1
token "[" means ans = 1
token "[-" means ans = 1
token "[::-" means ans = 1
token "[n" means ans = 1
token "]" means ans = 1
token "items" means ans = 1
token "join" means ans = 1
token "keys" means ans = 1
token "len" means ans = 1
token "lines" means ans = 1
token "list" means ans = 1
token "max" means ans = 1
token "min" means ans = 1
token "numbers" means ans = 1
token "result" means res = 1
token "sorted" means ans = 1
token "sum" means ans = 1
token "text" means ans = 1

# ─── 2. Gathering: the request line, seen from the "=" ───
#
# The prompt ends "# request\nresult =": the request starts three places back.
# Nothing past a newline counts, so an earlier line cannot leak in.

state isres, isnl, ask
attend back 1
    isres <- res
end
attend back 2
    isnl <- nl
end
entail ask when eq, isres, isnl

state cw[WINDOW], nw[WINDOW], hw[WINDOW], kw[WINDOW], open[WINDOW]
for c in 0 to WINDOW-1
    attend back c+3
        cw[c] <- w
        nw[c] <- nl
        hw[c] <- hash
        kw[c] <- kn
    end
    entail open[c] when (sum i in 0 to c : nw[i]) <= 0
end

state hits[24], hashes, comment, lost
for c in 0 to WINDOW-1
    for k in 1 to 23
        entail hits[k] when cw[c] == k, open[c], ask
    end
    entail hashes when hw[c] >= 1, open[c], ask
    entail lost when open[c], not kw[c], ask
end
entail comment when hashes >= 1

state c_text, c_items, c_numbers, c_words, c_lines, c_reverse, c_sort, c_desc, c_count, c_sum, c_max, c_min, c_longest, c_shortest, c_unique, c_upper, c_lower, c_first, c_last, c_even, c_odd, c_positive, c_negative
entail c_text when hits[W_text] >= 1
entail c_items when hits[W_items] >= 1
entail c_numbers when hits[W_numbers] >= 1
entail c_words when hits[W_words] >= 1
entail c_lines when hits[W_lines] >= 1
entail c_reverse when hits[W_reverse] >= 1
entail c_sort when hits[W_sort] >= 1
entail c_desc when hits[W_desc] >= 1
entail c_count when hits[W_count] >= 1
entail c_sum when hits[W_sum] >= 1
entail c_max when hits[W_max] >= 1
entail c_min when hits[W_min] >= 1
entail c_longest when hits[W_longest] >= 1
entail c_shortest when hits[W_shortest] >= 1
entail c_unique when hits[W_unique] >= 1
entail c_upper when hits[W_upper] >= 1
entail c_lower when hits[W_lower] >= 1
entail c_first when hits[W_first] >= 1
entail c_last when hits[W_last] >= 1
entail c_even when hits[W_even] >= 1
entail c_odd when hits[W_odd] >= 1
entail c_positive when hits[W_positive] >= 1
entail c_negative when hits[W_negative] >= 1

# ─── 3. What follows from the request ─────────────
#
# Each rule is something Python's documentation says. Anything that does not
# derive leaves `ok` unset, and the program says nothing: the host answers.

let nsrc = c_text + c_items + c_numbers
let nfilter = c_even + c_odd + c_positive + c_negative
let nagg = c_count + c_sum + c_max + c_min + c_longest + c_shortest + c_first + c_last + c_upper + c_lower

# What is being worked on. A string has words and lines; a list is already a sequence.
state one_src, obj_w, obj_l, s_str, noagg
entail one_src when nsrc == 1
entail obj_w when c_words, c_text
entail obj_l when c_lines, c_text, not c_words
entail s_str when c_text, not c_words, not c_lines
entail noagg when nagg <= 0
let s_strs = obj_w + obj_l + c_items
let s_num = c_numbers

# Order. Sorting in reverse is sorting descending, not sorting then reversing.
state o_sort, o_desc, o_rev
entail o_sort when c_sort, not c_reverse, not c_desc
entail o_desc when c_desc
entail o_desc when c_sort, c_reverse, not c_desc
entail o_rev when c_reverse, not c_sort, not c_desc

# Aggregates. max of numbers compares them; max of strings means the longest.
state a_len, a_sum, a_max, a_min, a_maxk, a_mink, a_first, a_last, a_up, a_lo
entail a_len when c_count
entail a_sum when c_sum
entail a_max when c_max, s_num
entail a_min when c_min, s_num
entail a_maxk when c_max, s_strs
entail a_mink when c_min, s_strs
entail a_maxk when c_longest, s_strs
entail a_mink when c_shortest, s_strs
entail a_first when c_first
entail a_last when c_last
entail a_up when c_upper
entail a_lo when c_lower

# Results. Reversed words are still a sentence; a sorted string is still a string.
state j_sp, j_em, u_on, f_on
entail j_sp when obj_w, o_rev, noagg
entail j_em when s_str, noagg, o_sort
entail j_em when s_str, noagg, o_desc
entail j_em when s_str, noagg, c_unique, not o_sort, not o_desc
entail u_on when c_unique
entail f_on when nfilter >= 1

state k_text, k_words, k_lines, k_items, k_numbers
entail k_text when s_str
entail k_words when obj_w
entail k_lines when obj_l
entail k_items when c_items
entail k_numbers when c_numbers

# What has no meaning. Only numbers add up or have parity; only strings have case;
# a string alone has no longest element to speak of.
state bad
entail bad when nagg >= 2
entail bad when nfilter >= 2
entail bad when f_on, not s_num
entail bad when c_sum, not s_num
entail bad when c_max, s_str
entail bad when c_min, s_str
entail bad when c_longest, s_num
entail bad when c_shortest, s_num
entail bad when c_longest, s_str
entail bad when c_shortest, s_str
entail bad when c_upper, not s_str
entail bad when c_lower, not s_str
entail bad when lost >= 1

let acted = nagg + nfilter + c_sort + c_reverse + c_desc + c_unique
state did, sound, ok
entail did when acted >= 1
entail sound when bad <= 0
entail ok when ask, comment, one_src, did, sound

# ─── 4. Spelling: each stage writes on from where the last stopped ───

const T1 = 1   # " "
const T2 = 2   # "\q"
const T3 = 3   # " \q."
const T4 = 4   # "join"
const T5 = 5   # "("
const T6 = 6   # "\q\q."
const T7 = 7   # "len"
const T8 = 8   # "sum"
const T9 = 9   # "max"
const T10 = 10   # "min"
const T11 = 11   # "sorted"
const T12 = 12   # "list"
const T13 = 13   # "(dict"
const T14 = 14   # ".from"
const T15 = 15   # "keys"
const T16 = 16   # "[n"
const T17 = 17   # " for"
const T18 = 18   # " n"
const T19 = 19   # " in"
const T20 = 20   # "text"
const T21 = 21   # ".split"
const T22 = 22   # "()"
const T23 = 23   # "lines"
const T24 = 24   # "items"
const T25 = 25   # "numbers"
const T26 = 26   # " if"
const T27 = 27   # " %"
const T28 = 28   # "2"
const T29 = 29   # " =="
const T30 = 30   # "0"
const T31 = 31   # "]"
const T32 = 32   # "1"
const T33 = 33   # " >"
const T34 = 34   # " <"
const T35 = 35   # "))"
const T36 = 36   # ")"
const T37 = 37   # ","
const T38 = 38   # " reverse"
const T39 = 39   # "=True"
const T40 = 40   # "[::-"
const T41 = 41   # " key"
const T42 = 42   # "=len"
const T43 = 43   # "["
const T44 = 44   # "[-"
const T45 = 45   # ".upper"
const T46 = 46   # ".lower"
const T47 = 47   # "\n"

state code[SLOTS]
state at0[SLOTS]
entail code[0] = T1 when ok
entail at0[1] when ok

# join open
state at1[SLOTS]
let any0 = j_em + j_sp
for i in 0 to SLOTS-6
    entail code[i+0] = T2 when at0[i], j_sp   # "\q"
    entail code[i+1] = T3 when at0[i], j_sp   # " \q."
    entail code[i+2] = T4 when at0[i], j_sp   # "join"
    entail code[i+3] = T5 when at0[i], j_sp   # "("
    entail at1[i+4] when at0[i], j_sp
    entail code[i+0] = T6 when at0[i], j_em   # "\q\q."
    entail code[i+1] = T4 when at0[i], j_em   # "join"
    entail code[i+2] = T5 when at0[i], j_em   # "("
    entail at1[i+3] when at0[i], j_em
    entail at1[i] when at0[i], not any0
end

# aggregate open
state at2[SLOTS]
let any1 = a_len + a_max + a_maxk + a_min + a_mink + a_sum
for i in 0 to SLOTS-4
    entail code[i+0] = T7 when at1[i], a_len   # "len"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_len   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_len
    entail code[i+0] = T8 when at1[i], a_sum   # "sum"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_sum   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_sum
    entail code[i+0] = T9 when at1[i], a_max   # "max"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_max   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_max
    entail code[i+0] = T9 when at1[i], a_maxk   # "max"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_maxk   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_maxk
    entail code[i+0] = T10 when at1[i], a_min   # "min"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_min   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_min
    entail code[i+0] = T10 when at1[i], a_mink   # "min"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at1[i], a_mink   # "("
    entail at2[i+2] when at1[i], a_mink
    entail at2[i] when at1[i], not any1
end

# order open
state at3[SLOTS]
let any2 = o_desc + o_sort
for i in 0 to SLOTS-4
    entail code[i+0] = T11 when at2[i], o_sort   # "sorted"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at2[i], o_sort   # "("
    entail at3[i+2] when at2[i], o_sort
    entail code[i+0] = T11 when at2[i], o_desc   # "sorted"
    entail code[i+1] = T5 when at2[i], o_desc   # "("
    entail at3[i+2] when at2[i], o_desc
    entail at3[i] when at2[i], not any2
end

# unique open
state at4[SLOTS]
let any3 = u_on
for i in 0 to SLOTS-7
    entail code[i+0] = T12 when at3[i], u_on   # "list"
    entail code[i+1] = T13 when at3[i], u_on   # "(dict"
    entail code[i+2] = T14 when at3[i], u_on   # ".from"
    entail code[i+3] = T15 when at3[i], u_on   # "keys"
    entail code[i+4] = T5 when at3[i], u_on   # "("
    entail at4[i+5] when at3[i], u_on
    entail at4[i] when at3[i], not any3
end

# filter open
state at5[SLOTS]
let any4 = f_on
for i in 0 to SLOTS-7
    entail code[i+0] = T16 when at4[i], f_on   # "[n"
    entail code[i+1] = T17 when at4[i], f_on   # " for"
    entail code[i+2] = T18 when at4[i], f_on   # " n"
    entail code[i+3] = T19 when at4[i], f_on   # " in"
    entail code[i+4] = T1 when at4[i], f_on   # " "
    entail at5[i+5] when at4[i], f_on
    entail at5[i] when at4[i], not any4
end

# core
state at6[SLOTS]
let any5 = k_items + k_lines + k_numbers + k_text + k_words
for i in 0 to SLOTS-6
    entail code[i+0] = T20 when at5[i], k_text   # "text"
    entail at6[i+1] when at5[i], k_text
    entail code[i+0] = T20 when at5[i], k_words   # "text"
    entail code[i+1] = T21 when at5[i], k_words   # ".split"
    entail code[i+2] = T22 when at5[i], k_words   # "()"
    entail at6[i+3] when at5[i], k_words
    entail code[i+0] = T20 when at5[i], k_lines   # "text"
    entail code[i+1] = T21 when at5[i], k_lines   # ".split"
    entail code[i+2] = T23 when at5[i], k_lines   # "lines"
    entail code[i+3] = T22 when at5[i], k_lines   # "()"
    entail at6[i+4] when at5[i], k_lines
    entail code[i+0] = T24 when at5[i], k_items   # "items"
    entail at6[i+1] when at5[i], k_items
    entail code[i+0] = T25 when at5[i], k_numbers   # "numbers"
    entail at6[i+1] when at5[i], k_numbers
    entail at6[i] when at5[i], not any5
end

# filter close
state at7[SLOTS]
let any6 = c_even + c_negative + c_odd + c_positive
for i in 0 to SLOTS-11
    entail code[i+0] = T26 when at6[i], c_even   # " if"
    entail code[i+1] = T18 when at6[i], c_even   # " n"
    entail code[i+2] = T27 when at6[i], c_even   # " %"
    entail code[i+3] = T1 when at6[i], c_even   # " "
    entail code[i+4] = T28 when at6[i], c_even   # "2"
    entail code[i+5] = T29 when at6[i], c_even   # " =="
    entail code[i+6] = T1 when at6[i], c_even   # " "
    entail code[i+7] = T30 when at6[i], c_even   # "0"
    entail code[i+8] = T31 when at6[i], c_even   # "]"
    entail at7[i+9] when at6[i], c_even
    entail code[i+0] = T26 when at6[i], c_odd   # " if"
    entail code[i+1] = T18 when at6[i], c_odd   # " n"
    entail code[i+2] = T27 when at6[i], c_odd   # " %"
    entail code[i+3] = T1 when at6[i], c_odd   # " "
    entail code[i+4] = T28 when at6[i], c_odd   # "2"
    entail code[i+5] = T29 when at6[i], c_odd   # " =="
    entail code[i+6] = T1 when at6[i], c_odd   # " "
    entail code[i+7] = T32 when at6[i], c_odd   # "1"
    entail code[i+8] = T31 when at6[i], c_odd   # "]"
    entail at7[i+9] when at6[i], c_odd
    entail code[i+0] = T26 when at6[i], c_positive   # " if"
    entail code[i+1] = T18 when at6[i], c_positive   # " n"
    entail code[i+2] = T33 when at6[i], c_positive   # " >"
    entail code[i+3] = T1 when at6[i], c_positive   # " "
    entail code[i+4] = T30 when at6[i], c_positive   # "0"
    entail code[i+5] = T31 when at6[i], c_positive   # "]"
    entail at7[i+6] when at6[i], c_positive
    entail code[i+0] = T26 when at6[i], c_negative   # " if"
    entail code[i+1] = T18 when at6[i], c_negative   # " n"
    entail code[i+2] = T34 when at6[i], c_negative   # " <"
    entail code[i+3] = T1 when at6[i], c_negative   # " "
    entail code[i+4] = T30 when at6[i], c_negative   # "0"
    entail code[i+5] = T31 when at6[i], c_negative   # "]"
    entail at7[i+6] when at6[i], c_negative
    entail at7[i] when at6[i], not any6
end

# unique close
state at8[SLOTS]
let any7 = u_on
for i in 0 to SLOTS-3
    entail code[i+0] = T35 when at7[i], u_on   # "))"
    entail at8[i+1] when at7[i], u_on
    entail at8[i] when at7[i], not any7
end

# order close
state at9[SLOTS]
let any8 = o_desc + o_rev + o_sort
for i in 0 to SLOTS-6
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at8[i], o_sort   # ")"
    entail at9[i+1] when at8[i], o_sort
    entail code[i+0] = T37 when at8[i], o_desc   # ","
    entail code[i+1] = T38 when at8[i], o_desc   # " reverse"
    entail code[i+2] = T39 when at8[i], o_desc   # "=True"
    entail code[i+3] = T36 when at8[i], o_desc   # ")"
    entail at9[i+4] when at8[i], o_desc
    entail code[i+0] = T40 when at8[i], o_rev   # "[::-"
    entail code[i+1] = T32 when at8[i], o_rev   # "1"
    entail code[i+2] = T31 when at8[i], o_rev   # "]"
    entail at9[i+3] when at8[i], o_rev
    entail at9[i] when at8[i], not any8
end

# aggregate close
state at10[SLOTS]
let any9 = a_first + a_last + a_len + a_lo + a_max + a_maxk + a_min + a_mink + a_sum + a_up
for i in 0 to SLOTS-6
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at9[i], a_len   # ")"
    entail at10[i+1] when at9[i], a_len
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at9[i], a_sum   # ")"
    entail at10[i+1] when at9[i], a_sum
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at9[i], a_max   # ")"
    entail at10[i+1] when at9[i], a_max
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at9[i], a_min   # ")"
    entail at10[i+1] when at9[i], a_min
    entail code[i+0] = T37 when at9[i], a_maxk   # ","
    entail code[i+1] = T41 when at9[i], a_maxk   # " key"
    entail code[i+2] = T42 when at9[i], a_maxk   # "=len"
    entail code[i+3] = T36 when at9[i], a_maxk   # ")"
    entail at10[i+4] when at9[i], a_maxk
    entail code[i+0] = T37 when at9[i], a_mink   # ","
    entail code[i+1] = T41 when at9[i], a_mink   # " key"
    entail code[i+2] = T42 when at9[i], a_mink   # "=len"
    entail code[i+3] = T36 when at9[i], a_mink   # ")"
    entail at10[i+4] when at9[i], a_mink
    entail code[i+0] = T43 when at9[i], a_first   # "["
    entail code[i+1] = T30 when at9[i], a_first   # "0"
    entail code[i+2] = T31 when at9[i], a_first   # "]"
    entail at10[i+3] when at9[i], a_first
    entail code[i+0] = T44 when at9[i], a_last   # "[-"
    entail code[i+1] = T32 when at9[i], a_last   # "1"
    entail code[i+2] = T31 when at9[i], a_last   # "]"
    entail at10[i+3] when at9[i], a_last
    entail code[i+0] = T45 when at9[i], a_up   # ".upper"
    entail code[i+1] = T22 when at9[i], a_up   # "()"
    entail at10[i+2] when at9[i], a_up
    entail code[i+0] = T46 when at9[i], a_lo   # ".lower"
    entail code[i+1] = T22 when at9[i], a_lo   # "()"
    entail at10[i+2] when at9[i], a_lo
    entail at10[i] when at9[i], not any9
end

# join close
state at11[SLOTS]
let any10 = j_em + j_sp
for i in 0 to SLOTS-3
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at10[i], j_sp   # ")"
    entail at11[i+1] when at10[i], j_sp
    entail code[i+0] = T36 when at10[i], j_em   # ")"
    entail at11[i+1] when at10[i], j_em
    entail at11[i] when at10[i], not any10
end

# The end of the line.
for i in 0 to SLOTS-1
    entail code[i] = T47 when at11[i]
end

# ─── 5. Writing: each answer token looks back at the "=" for its own slot ───

state aw[SLOTS], ww[SLOTS], from[SLOTS]
for c in 1 to SLOTS-1
    attend back c
        aw[c] <- ask
        ww[c] <- ans
    end
end
entail from[0] when ask
entail from[1] when aw[1], ans
for c in 2 to SLOTS-1
    entail from[c] when aw[c], ans + (sum i in 1 to c-1 : ww[i]) >= c
end

state seen[SLOTS]
attend back by from
    for s in 0 to SLOTS-1
        seen[s] <- code[s]
    end
end

state say
for s in 0 to SLOTS-1
    entail say = seen[s] when from[s]
end

state o[48]
entail o[1] when say == 1
